checks.title: Manual: verify a pre-login banner / MOTD is configured
checks.audit: Run 'show running-config | include banner' and confirm a banner is present.
checks.rationale: Pre-login banners can support legal notice and incident response.

checks.title: Manual: confirm device firmware is on a supported release
checks.audit: Run 'show version' and verify the train is supported by the vendor.
checks.rationale: End-of-life firmware does not receive security patches.
checks.remediation: Plan firmware upgrade per the vendor advisory.

checks.title: Manual: ensure SNMP communities are not default
checks.audit: Inspect SNMP configuration for community strings such as 'public' or 'private'.
checks.rationale: Default communities allow trivial information disclosure.
checks.remediation: Replace SNMP communities with strong, unique values; prefer SNMPv3 with auth+priv.
